week_themes.title: Foundations
week_themes.focus: Find the right muscles, learn to let them go, and slow your breathing.

week_themes.title: Awareness
week_themes.focus: Notice tension, thoughts and sensations without judging them.

week_themes.title: Control
week_themes.focus: Practise techniques step by step and build pelvic-floor endurance.

week_themes.title: Confidence
week_themes.focus: Work on unhelpful thoughts and stay with sensation, not performance.

week_themes.title: Building
week_themes.focus: Longer holds, more practice and steady lifestyle habits.

week_themes.title: Integration
week_themes.focus: Bring breathing and relaxation into everyday moments.

week_themes.title: Connection
week_themes.focus: Communication, pacing and closeness, solo or with a partner.

week_themes.title: Consolidate
week_themes.focus: Keep what works, plan your next steps and celebrate progress.
